events.title: Moves to New York City
events.description: After Big Lots closes, Keith relocates from Connecticut and the evidence archive starts to take shape in a new city.

events.title: Origin sprint begins
events.description: Keith realizes he needs a better way to organize the evidence collected against Dunton Consulting, and GestaltView begins as a necessity.

events.title: First formal schema artifact
events.description: The first structured schema artifact appears and gives the project a durable shape.

events.title: Seed prompt copyright notice
events.description: The GestaltView seed prompt receives a formal copyright notice, anchoring the language and methodology.

events.title: Origin transcript recorded
events.description: A transcript records the origin narrative and the founding conditions that shaped the runtime.
